title: TDS Invoice Total
description: Stops Indian freelancers being short-paid by working out fee + GST − TDS = what lands in the bank, with the right rate and section for the invoice date (10% professional, 2% technical, 1%/2% contract; s.393 of the 2025 Act, was 194J/194C) and the yearly threshold, then flagging TDS taken on the GST, the wrong rate and the 20% rate without a PAN, with a one-tap fix and a ready note for the client.
stops: Freelancer short-paid after TDS on GST
